description: Circular Gauge is a Power BI custom visual that displays a primary measure as a circular gauge (outer ring) and an optional comparison/target measure as an inner ring. Use it for KPI cards and scorecards where you want to see progress toward a goal at a glance. The visual supports configurable decimals, value/difference/% change display toggles, legend placement, and color/font styling through the Power BI formatting pane. Typical uses Progress toward a target (Actual vs Target) Period-over-period comparison (Current vs Previous/Benchmark) Any % or ratio metric you want to show as a gauge Data fields Value (outer ring): Measure Comparison (inner ring): Measure (optional)
